# omniddi_network_space (Data Source)

Looks up a network space by `id` or exact `name`. Reading network spaces needs a platform role with `read_network_spaces`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "omniddi_network_space" "lab" {
  name = "lab"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) Network space id. Set exactly one of `id` or `name`.
- `name` (String) Exact network space name. Set exactly one of `id` or `name`.

### Read-Only

- `available` (Boolean) Whether the space is active and current, so it can be worked in.
- `description` (String) Description of the space.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the default space.
- `server_count` (Number) Number of servers in the space.
- `state` (String) `PROVISIONING`, `ACTIVE`, `INACTIVE` or `DELETING`.
